title: Filtering the sales table by numbers · part 20

steps.title: Filter then sort: employee_id != 3
steps.prompt:
Filter first, then ORDER BY tidies what is left.
LIMIT 3 keeps the top of that sorted list.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE employee_id != 3 ORDER BY employee_id LIMIT 3;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM sales.
Add WHERE employee_id != 3.
Add ORDER BY employee_id LIMIT 3.
Write: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE employee_id != 3 ORDER BY employee_id LIMIT 3;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE employee_id != 3 ORDER BY employee_id LIMIT 3;
steps.memory_trick: WHERE trims, ORDER BY sorts, LIMIT cuts.
